A '''stenographic recorder''' was a feature of the [[3D-4X administrative droid]]. Alongside the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] inbuilt [[Microphone/Legends|microphone]], the recorder assisted the unit in recording business meetings and presentations.<ref name="EGTD" />
